We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We have guidance: three steps enumerated in order they must be applied (forward). Steps: 1) Carboxylic acid to amide coupling (amide formation). 2) Doebner modification (aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid). 3) Sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride). So retrosynthetic direction: target -> break amide to give acid + amine (step 1 reversed). Then break α,β-unsaturated acid to aldehyde + malonic acid (step 2 reversed). Then break sulfonamide to amine + sulfonyl chloride (step 3 reversed). So we need to find precursors: final target has sulfonamide linking a tolyl amine to a phenyl sulfone attached to a phenyl with α,β-unsaturated amide side chain.

Let's identify fragments:

Target: p-tolyl (CH3 on phenyl) attached via NH to sulfonyl group (SO2) attached to another phenyl (para-substituted) which has a side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2 (anilide). Actually side chain: /C=C/ (trans) attached to carbonyl amide linking to an aniline (c3ccccc3N). So the side chain is cinnamoyl amide with an aniline at the amide nitrogen.

Thus retrosynthesis:

Step 1 (reverse amide formation): break amide C(=O)-N bond to give carboxylic acid (the α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So precursor 1: α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid attached to phenyl sulfone: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2)cc1 (i.e., same but acid instead of amide). Precursor 2: aniline (c3ccccc3N). Good.

Step 2 (reverse Doebner): break α,β-unsaturated acid to give aromatic aldehyde (on phenyl sulfone) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). The aldehyde would be on the phenyl sulfone: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(CHO)cc2)cc1. So precursor: aldehyde phenyl sulfone plus malonic acid.

Step 3 (reverse sulfonamide formation): break sulfonamide to give tolyl amine (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl chloride (p-tolyl? Actually sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl sulfone). The sulfonyl chloride would be Cl-SO2-Ph-CHO (or after step 2, the phenyl with aldehyde). So precursor: p-toluidine (CH3-Ph-NH2) and sulfonyl chloride: Cl[S](=O)(=O)c2ccc(CHO)cc2.

Thus we have three steps.

Now we need to construct JSON route with type "mol" root target, children reaction nodes each with template_id. Need template IDs for each transformation. We have template for sulfonamide formation (reverse). From earlier search, template 733 is sulfonamide formation (retro: sulfonamide -> sulfonyl chloride + amine). That matches step 3. So we can use template_id "733".

For amide formation (reverse), need template that breaks amide to acid + amine. Search maybe template exists. Let's search for amide formation reverse (i.e., amide -> acid + amine). Use functional groups broken: amide, formed: carboxylic acid, primary amine.
